notes: Example catalog record, written by hand for the scaffold — not crawled. Tailwind Plus is the commercial component and template library from Tailwind Labs, previously sold as Tailwind UI. Access is a paid one-time license covering HTML, React, and Vue examples on Tailwind CSS. As of September 2026, new customer sign-ups were reported closed after Tailwind Labs joined Shopify; existing licenses kept access. Confirm the current offer on the official site before treating this as something you can buy.
